description: This file contains functions that modify build configuration files and environment variables for a specific embedded Linux build system, particularly for the RDK eSDK environment. It includes functions to write configuration files, modify layer settings, and copy kernel images based on machine overrides.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Writes 'meta/conf' to the 'conf/templateconf.cfg' file if it exists in the build directory.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes 'conf/templateconf.cfg' if certain machine overrides are present, to prevent build issues.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Appends a generic layer path to 'BBLAYERS' if specific machine overrides are present.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies 'bblayers.conf' to set 'RDKROOT', removes the generic layer if needed, and copies kernel images for specific machines, also appends 'post-build' to 'local.conf'.
